pfas_definition.provenance: SECTION 3. A person may not sell, offer for sale or distribute in or into this state polystyrene foam containers or polystyrene foam packaging peanuts. SECTION 4. A person may not sell, offer for sale, or distribute in or into this state a foodware container containing perfluoroalkyl or polyfluoroalkyl substances.

type.provenance: SECTION 2. (1) A food vendor may not use a polystyrene foam container in selling, offering for sale, serving or dispensing prepared food to a consumer. (2) A food vendor may not provide to a consumer a foodware container that is intended for a single use unless the foodware container: (a) Is made from fiber-based materials; (b) Has been certified as compostable under section 5 of this 2023 Act; or (c) Is included on the uniform statewide collection list established under ORS 459A.914.

date.provenance: SECTION 6. The Environmental Quality Commission may adopt rules necessary to implement sections 1 to 4 of this 2023 Act.

products: foodware containers containing perfluoroalkyl or polyfluoroalkyl substances
exceptions: polystyrene foam containers that are intended for more than one use and enclosed by a solid shell
trays or containers used solely to store, ship or transport an ingredient or food product that is not prepared food
polystyrene plastic material used solely for packing or protecting other items during storage, shipping or other transportation
